defects.defective_behaviour: Tokenised on '=' only; auditd 3.0.7 emits `key value` lines, so the parser produced {} and AUDIT_LOSS_AND_BACKLOG_ZERO_PRE_RUN=BLOCKED despite lost 0 / backlog 0 being present.
defects.fix: parse_audit_status_text() accepts `key value` and `key=value`, requires integer values, and drops any key whose occurrences disagree so the gate fails closed.
defects.frozen_contract_basis: Matches the frozen harness parse_audit_status(), which already used the space-delimited form rf'\\b{key}\\s+(\\d+)'. The defective preflight was out of parity with the harness it gates; the fix restores parity rather than inventing a rule.

defects.finding: auditctl -l never executed. returncode is null and stderr is the Python wrapper's exception text 'PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted', which is the except branch of run(), not auditctl output. stdout '' is that branch's hardcoded default and e3b0c442...b855 is sha256(b''), the hash of nothing -- not an alternative rendering of an empty rule set. observed_rule_lines=[] is likewise an artifact of the non-execution.
defects.fix: None to the predicate. The raw dump hash and rule lines are retained as evidence, and the gate now reports why it blocked (AUDITCTL_LIST_NOT_EXECUTED vs PREEXISTING_AUDIT_RULES_PRESENT vs RULE_DUMP_HASH_NOT_FROZEN_EMPTY_BASELINE) instead of collapsing every cause into one hash mismatch.
defects.open_question: Whether this host's auditctl -l actually emits 'No rules\n' is still unobserved and is what the remediated re-run must establish.
defects.reported_claim: observed_rule_dump_sha256 e3b0c442... shows this host renders an empty rule set as empty stdout, so the literal 'No rules\n' hash is not a stable predicate.

defects.defective_behaviour: run() returns returncode=None when the subprocess raises. Predicates written as `returncode != 0` (interfaces_clean, clean_ovs) evaluate None != 0 as True, so a command that never executed was scored as positive evidence of a clean host.
defects.fix: Every command record now carries executed:bool. command_executed(), device_absent(), ovs_bridge_absent(), audit_status_gate() and empty_rule_baseline_gate() all require proof of execution and fail closed without it.
defects.historical_reach: The same pattern is present in the prior blocked package's PRE_RUNTIME_PREREQUISITES.json, where ovs_bridge and tcpdump_processes both recorded PermissionError with returncode null while reserved_interfaces_clean and ovs_bridge_s1_absent were reported true.

integrity_finding.detail: Two preflight runs occurred. The wrapper run (execution/preflight_timing.json) ran 11:45:33Z-11:47:09Z rc=2 and its stdout is preserved as preflight_stdout.RUN1_20260907T114709Z.log. A second run at 11:54:48Z-11:55:24Z overwrote 03_PRE_RUNTIME_PREREQUISITE_MATRIX.json in place, so RUN1's matrix bytes no longer exist. The two surviving records disagree: RUN1 stdout reports REQUIRED_PRIVILEGES_AVAILABLE=BLOCKED / CLEAN_PRE_RUNTIME_STATE=PASS, RUN2 JSON reports REQUIRED_PRIVILEGES_AVAILABLE=PASS / CLEAN_PRE_RUNTIME_STATE=BLOCKED.
integrity_finding.remediation: The remediated preflight now writes an immutable per-run copy under failed_preflight_evidence/03_PRE_RUNTIME_PREREQUISITE_MATRIX.RUN_<utc>.json in addition to the canonical 03_ file.
